definitions.explanation: A request for information, typically addressed to a company, organization, or authority.
The act of getting in touch with someone for information or assistance.

⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb.
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to inquire, to contact
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make an inquiry

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ: inquiry (polite, often seen in business contexts)
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: contact information
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: inquiry counter/desk
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ⟦フォーム→フォーム：29244_foomu⟧: contact form

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
- Websites often have an 「お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ」 page for customer inquiries
- Customer service departments handle {問|と}い{合|あ}わせ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧

REGISTER:
The お prefix is almost always used in business and formal contexts.
